Welcome

Answer a short questionnaire. Try a trial pack of 3 to 4 perfumes matched to you. Then buy the one you love.

For 18 to 30 year olds still searching for their scent

The problem

Buying perfume online is a guess.

  • 01You cannot test the scent before you pay.
  • 02Notes like “oud” and “bergamot” read like jargon.
  • 03A blind full bottle is an expensive way to find out you dislike it.

How it works

Four steps from “I have no idea” to “that’s mine”.

No blind buys. You try first, and only then pay for a full bottle.

1

Tell us about you

A short questionnaire on your taste, mood and budget. About two minutes.

2

We match you

Our algorithm turns your answers into a shortlist of perfumes that fit.

3

Try before you buy

Get a trial pack of 3 to 4 of the suggested perfumes at an affordable price.

4

Buy what you love

Now you know what you like. Buy the full bottle from us.
